createTask: Plan a new task. Use it when the person asks to create, add, or assign a task. Returns a plan for the person to confirm.
updateTask: Plan changes to an existing task: title, status, priority, due date, or assignee. Returns a plan for the person to confirm.
searchTasks: Find tasks. Give a query to search by title, or leave it out and filter by status, mine, or overdue.
getMyDay: Summarise a day: tasks due, overdue work, meetings, reminders, team items, and learning.
getCalendar: List calendar entries (events, meetings, and task deadlines) between two dates, up to 31 days.
createReminder: Plan a personal reminder at a date and time. Returns a plan for the person to confirm.
searchProjects: Find projects by name or code, with progress and open task counts.
getProjectStatus: Get one project's status: progress, open, completed and blocked tasks, upcoming deadlines, and workload.
searchTeam: Find people by name, email, designation, or department.
getTeamWorkload: Show each team member's assigned, in-progress, completed, overdue, and blocked tasks.
searchNotes: Search general notes, learning notes, and meeting notes by text.
createMeetingNote: Plan additions to a meeting's notes: discussion, decisions, or follow-ups. Existing notes are kept. Returns a plan for the person to confirm.
createLearningNote: Plan a new note on a learning topic. Returns a plan for the person to confirm.
getLearningProgress: Get learning progress: overall progress, topics in progress, completed topics, and upcoming targets.
